messages:
lina: Heads-up — replay kicked off for 2026-03-15..2026-03-17 window and we bumped into tenant preemptions on shard-12. Observed lots of tiny slices causing slot churn.
aj: Ugh. Which routing policy did the scheduler pick? gentle vs strict?
lina: It fell back to strict because quota for the tenant was flagged as high-risk. That caused preemptive eviction of smaller slices.
sam: Can we add a short grace window for late telemetry so small slices batch instead of being preempted immediately? Even 30s could help with hotspot smoothing.
nora: Agree. Grace window sounds reasonable. Need to be careful with SLOs — we don't want end-to-end latency regressions for recent data that apps depend on.
aj: Proposal: introduce `replay_grace_ms` at job level and a scheduler tweak to prefer consolidating slices < 50ms into a slightly delayed batch. Default 30000.
lina: Also add quota leak detection: if a tenant is close to quota and gets preempted repeatedly, surface that in console as "replay starvation" with suggested mitigation (raise commit or temp allowlist).
devex: For console UX — simple banner on the replay job page that shows "Estimated delay due to batching: ~30s" and a toggle to opt-out per-run. Keep it small.
ingest-bot: Scheduled replay job 4445678901 started by lina. shards affected: shard-12, shard-13. estimated tokens: 1.2M. route_policy: strict -> fallback.
sam: Implementation note: the scheduler currently ranks by tenant weight then slice size. We need to add a third key: (slice_age_bucket) so slightly younger slices wait for the grace window.
aj: I can prototype change in scheduler: add TTL bucket and a tunable: max_grace_slices per slot. Will add unit tests.
lina: Thanks. Also can we have a cheap dashboard metric: percent_replays_batched_vs_preempted per tenant. That will help decide defaults.
nora: Add alert when preempt_rate > 5% for 10m for any tenant with >100k tokens queued.
devex: I'll mock a console card for that metric. Quick question: do we want to expose `replay_grace_ms` via API and CLI?
aj: Yes. API param for job create, CLI flag `--grace-ms`. Example:

```
replayctl create --range 2026-03-15,2026-03-17 --shards shard-12 --grace-ms 30000 --priority low
```

lina: Nice. Can you add a fallback cap so grace doesn't delay the whole run indefinitely? e.g., per-slice max 60s.
aj: Will do. Also will put a circuit-breaker: if queue backlog > 4h then disable grace to catch up.
sam: One more thing — KV cache rehydrate interactions. If we delay small slices, we might increase KV reuse. Good, but if we delay too long we risk cache eviction. Add a metric for kv_cache_hit_rate during replays.
ora: Sounds good. Next steps: aj to draft scheduler PR, devex to prototype console banner + metric card, lina to run a small canary job with grace-ms=30s against shard-12 tomorrow morning.
lina: I'll do canary at 07:30 PST. tagging aj + devex for followups. :thumbsup:
